question: Is there an untouched evaluation for a NARROWER estimand related to the primary question: does a history-derived joint confirmation rate rank candidates better for confirmed yield / confirmation than simple marginal or response rankings, with identical information?
rule: design metadata only for unopened data; no outcome column of any unopened file was parsed (explicit allow lists in design_census.py, design_census_addendum1, design_census_vis*.py). Jaaks 2022 is exposed; its design columns were read freely.
verdict_overall: ONE CANDIDATE QUALIFIES (conditionally on pre-registered gates): the Vis et al. 2024 pan-cancer anchored screen (Cell Rep Med 5:101687), whose 19 ordered combinations were measured in two separate screening projects (GDSC_002 and GDSC_005) on different plates at identical concentrations in 730 lines. Proposal: verify/untouched_plan.json (not frozen; no outcome opened), with a design-only partition of 710 eligible lines into E = 298 / H = 412 (every Jaaks line in H). It is a different estimand (same-condition cross-run confirmation, not orientation swap) and is likely underpowered for tau = 0.05. Because the Jaaks primary is EXPLORATORY_WORTHWHILE_EXCLUDED (contract: STOP), running it is optional and is the parent's decision. Every other candidate is NOT_QUALIFIED or UNVERIFIED; no blocking receipt is written because one candidate qualifies.

candidates.name: Vis et al. 2024 Cell Rep Med pan-cancer anchored screen, cross-project repeats (Data S1 pancan_combi_fitted_data_jan21.tsv.gz)
candidates.status_in_programme: UNTOUCHED: never opened by any study in this repository (grep of research/, src/, tools/ for the DOI / PMCID / title: no hit); downloaded 2026-10-04 13:01 by this workstream; only design columns parsed. The paper text read (aggregate synergy rate 12%, combination-level concordance with Jaaks) is disclosed.
candidates.estimand: R vs development-selected strongest simple same-information predictor C*: confirmed yield under the contract-v2 P2 campaign (two rounds, cap M = ceil(0.2 x menu), integer arithmetic, same predictors and tie rule), where screen = the measurement of an ordered combination in one project and confirmation = the same ordered combination at identical concentrations on different plates of the other project (two role assignments per line, paired). Population: new lines of the same tissues, this 19-combination menu, this history library. Secondary: within-line concordance (AUC) of the screen score with the joint call.

design_facts.release: 137,738 rows, 762 lines, 26 tissues, 2,953 plates (barcodes; one scan each), 9 anchors x 26 libraries = 51 ordered combinations, 6 drug sets in 3 projects x 2 line arms (GDSC_002 A/B, GDSC_004 A/B, GDSC_005 A/B: arms split lines, they are not replicates)
design_facts.menu: 19 ordered combinations shared by GDSC_002 and GDSC_005 with identical anchor concentrations and library maximum concentration (a 20th shared combination, MK-1775 + temozolomide, changes anchor concentration and is excluded); complete in 730 lines (pre-QC), 20 tissues with >= 10 such lines (Lung 134, Haematopoietic 128, Breast 43, Large Intestine 40, CNS 36, Bone 34, ...)
design_facts.independence_of_the_two_measurements: different project, drug-set layout and plates (0 shared barcodes); minimum barcode distance between the two projects' plates 5,173 (median 11,934), i.e. separate screening runs; identical compound IDs and concentrations; cell-line batch (CL) disjoint for every candidate in 163 lines and shared in the other 567 (same stock batch, different run); no seeding or scan dates in the release (a single fit time stamp 2021-01-12); all plates fitted in one hierarchical model run (shared line-level curve parameters: the fitted values are not statistically independent, exactly as for the Jaaks SV/VS orientations)
design_facts.replicates_inside_a_project: 102 of 730 lines have > 1 plate for some (combination, project) (reference/QC lines); the authors' >= half rule aggregates them
design_facts.overlap_with_exposed_jaaks: 116 Jaaks lines are in the release (109 with the complete 19-menu); 0 barcodes shared with Jaaks's 3,106 plates; 1,630 line x menu-combination cells also measured in Jaaks (exposed screen; not used by the proposal)

candidates.legal_predictor_information: history = both projects' calls and labels of the H lines of the same tissue (stage 1: opened for history, C*/fp* selection and power only); target information = only purchased measurements; E-line outcomes sealed until the analysis freeze (staged parsing that drops E rows before any outcome column is converted)
candidates.power: not computable from design counts alone (needs the variance of the paired line difference). Planning relation: 95% relative half-width hw ~ 1.96 x SD(paired line difference) / (mean C* line yield x sqrt(n_E)); with n_E = 298, hw = 0.114 x (SD/mean). Jaaks gave SD/mean ~ 0.22 (verify-hits, statistics.json) and ~ 0.30 (this study's P2 primary, from its interval), but the 19-menu with M = 4 (two screens, two verification slots) has small-count yields; SD/mean ~ 0.7-1.5 is expected, i.e. hw ~ 8-17%. The proposal computes the projection from H lines (gate G4) and records it before stage-2 (E) access.
candidates.verdict: QUALIFIED_FOR_CROSS_RUN_CONFIRMATION_YIELD (design; conditional on gates G1-G4 in untouched_plan.json; power UNVERIFIED and likely insufficient for tau = 0.05: resolves tau only if the H-projected SD/mean <= ~0.44)
